title: AllowanceTransactionsDTO
description: AllowanceTransactionsDTO schema from Account Management OpenAPI Specification

programCodeInfo.description: Statutory or regulatory based options for tracking and reducing air pollution emissions.

transactionId.description: The number used to identify a specific allowance transaction.

transactionTotal.description: The total number of allowances involved in a transaction.

transactionType.description: The type of allowance transaction (e.g. initial allocation, private transaction, etc.).

sellAccountNumber.description: The number of the account transferring allowances in an allowance transaction.

sellAccountName.description: The name of the account transferring allowances in an allowance transaction.

sellAccountType.description: Type of seller's allowance account (Facility, General, etc.).

sellFacilityName.description: For facility and unit accounts, the facility name of the account transferring allowances in an allowance transaction.

sellFacilityId.description: For facility and unit accounts, the Facility ID of the account transferring allowances in an allowance transaction.

sellState.description: For facility and unit accounts, the state of the account transferring allowances in an allowance transaction.

sellEpaRegion.description: For facility and unit accounts, the EPA Region of the account transferring allowances in an allowance transaction.

sellSourceCategory.description: For unit accounts, the source category of the account transferring allowances in an allowance transaction.

sellOwner.description: The owner of the account transferring allowances in an allowance transaction.
sellOwner.example: AEP Generation Resources, Inc.|Buckeye Power, Inc.

buyAccountNumber.description: The number of the account receiving allowances in an allowance transaction.

buyAccountName.description: The name of the account receiving allowances in an allowance transaction.

buyAccountType.description: Type of buyer's allowance account (Facility, General, etc.).

buyFacilityName.description: For facility and unit accounts, the facility name of the account receiving allowances in an allowance transaction.

buyFacilityId.description: For facility and unit accounts, the Facility ID of the account receiving allowances in an allowance transaction.

buyState.description: For facility and unit accounts, the state of the account receiving allowances in an allowance transaction.

buyEpaRegion.description: For facility and unit accounts, the EPA Region of the account receiving allowances in an allowance transaction.

buySourceCategory.description: For unit accounts, the source category of the account receiving allowances in an allowance transaction.

buyOwner.description: The owner of the account receiving allowances in an allowance transaction.

transactionDate.description: The date the allowance transaction was confirmed.

vintageYear.description: Year allowance becomes eligible for use in compliance.

startBlock.description: The starting serial number of an allowance block.

endBlock.description: The ending serial number of an allowance block.

totalBlock.description: The quantity of allowances as identified by the Start Serial Number through End Serial Number.
